summary: Grab Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a press release announcing routine board refreshment. John Rogers retires from the Board and Audit Committee effective October 31, 2026, after a five-year term, and remains an advisor for transition. Sean Sullivan, EVP and CFO of Acushnet Holdings, joins the Board and Audit Committee effective December 1, 2026. No terms, prices, stakes, premiums, advisors, or structural mechanics are involved. This is a scheduled, non-forced succession rather than an abrupt departure; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
